## Problem

What problem does this solve? Is there a workaround today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the desired behavior. If it's a new MCP tool, include:
- Tool name (snake_case)
- Parameters (name, type, required/optional)
- Return shape
- One example call

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why this one?

## On-prem vs cloud

Does this work differently for on-prem TFS vs Azure DevOps Services?
